messages:
emma: Quick sync — BridgeKey asked for final prep checklist for HSM BYOK + SSO + SCIM + marketplace launch. Need owners for SAML metadata, SCIM attr map, KMS IAM policy, PKCS#11 verification, marketplace bundle, and press embargo. Assign please.
liam: I’ll own SAML metadata + metadata endpoint. Recommend nameID persistent + email as subject. Will push metadata XML to /metadata/bridgekey.xml.
omar: I’ll do KMS/IAM policy + key lifecycle tests. Plan: create test-key with policy allowing HSM-backed KMS only. Will add rotation automation notes.
beth (BridgeKey): We’ll provide pkcs11.so, firmware v3.2.1, and connector checksum. Need you to pin connector to v2.3. Also require SCIM attribute "externalId" mapped to bridge_id.
andrea: Marketplace bundle and docs. Need logo SVG, 100-word blurb, pricing SKU, and 2 screenshots. I’ll loop in marketing for screenshots.
maria (legal): Embargo review: submit marketing assets by 2026-05-12 11:59 PT for 48h legal review. No press until signoff.
emma: Proposed dry-run: 2026-05-14 09:00 PT in staging. Need a 6-step smoke test script. Liam/Omar can you draft?
liam: Draft smoke test path saved at integrations/bridgekey/smoke.md. Steps (short): 1) upload SAML metadata, 2) apply SCIM mapping, 3) create user via SCIM, 4) provision HSM-backed key, 5) sign payload, 6) read secret via API.
omar: Smoke CLI snippets I’ll add to repo:
  rctl hsm connect --provider bridgekey --so /opt/bridge/pkcs11.so --serial BK-9987
  rctl kms create-key --policy-file bridgekey-policy.json --origin hsm
  rctl kms sign --key-id test-key --payload "test"
Include negative case: revoke TLS cert and expect HSM operations to fail + graceful error.
beth (BridgeKey): Staging dry-run OK from our side. We’ll run firmware validation on 2026-05-13 and send results + signed checksum. Connector pinning and 30d rotation acknowledged.
integrations-bot: Jira epic REDWOOD-5420 created and linked: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REDWOOD-5420
andrea: I’ll assemble the support runbook and oncall POC list. Need BridgeKey ops contact for escalation matrix, @beth please DM.
beth (BridgeKey): Sent DM with vault-ops@bridgekey.com and pager info. Confirming connector pin to v2.3 and rotation window 30d.
emma: Thanks everyone. Next check-in Tue 09:30 PT. If legal/security blocks surface earlier tag @maria. :thumbsup:
